assets.prompt: Create a premium Japanese arcade sweets-game logo, landscape 2:1 composition on a fully transparent background. The ONLY readable text is the exact Japanese game name 「ダンゴデビンゴ」, rendered accurately as one joyful but clearly readable line in chunky polished 3D lettering: warm strawberry pink, ivory cream, fresh matcha green, golden biscuit outlines, subtle glossy candy highlights. Decorative motif: three round Japanese dango dumplings in pink, white and pale green, on two delicate bamboo skewers, with a small triangular arrangement of dango echoing a bingo board. Integrate the skewers behind and through the dumpling motifs; no extra words, no English, no numbers, no additional logos. Friendly high-quality arcade cabinet identity, rounded confectionery forms with realistic sweet texture, warm studio lighting, clean readable silhouette at small sizes. Keep all content comfortably within frame; substantial transparent padding around artwork. The text is the dominant focal point. Asset for a Japanese web arcade called SWEETS LINK, matching rich glossy sweets themed game logos.
